edbDesc: The heating of a solid body produced by the passage of fluid (such as air) over a body such as a meteor, missile, or airplane. It is a form of forced convection in that the flow field is created by forces beyond those associated with the thermal processes.
title: Aerodynamic Heating
pickWhy: A mix of air friction and compression heating on fast objects, mostly a hazard; the useful core is the adiabatic heating card.
